name: China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd.
summary: China Fortune Land Development Co., Ltd. (CFLD) specializes in the comprehensive development, construction, investment, and ongoing management of both new industrial parks and commercial real estate ventures. The company's activities extend across China, Indonesia, and various other international markets. Established in 1998, the firm transitioned to its current name in December 2007, having previously operated as China Fortune Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. CFLD's corporate headquarters are situated in Beijing, China.
